brief.headline: SpaceX beats earnings; Musk floats Tesla merger
brief.detail: SpaceX shares jumped 8% after its third-quarter revenue growth beat expectations, and Musk floated a potential SpaceX-Tesla merger, which investors are weighing.

brief.headline: Meta plans new non-voting stock class to fund AI
brief.detail: Meta plans a new non-voting stock class it could use to fund heavy AI spending, and the company said it won't affect Mark Zuckerberg's voting control.

brief.headline: Netflix shares slide on weak outlook
brief.detail: Netflix shares fell as a weak outlook deepened worries about viewership and revenue growth.

brief.headline: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion to New Mexico
brief.detail: A New Mexico jury found Meta misled consumers about data privacy, and the company was ordered to pay $25 billion.

brief.headline: French borrowing costs hit 5%, highest since 2002
brief.detail: France's 10-year borrowing costs hit 5% for the first time since 2002, as concerns over public finances and political stability grew.
